Nigeria Customs Service, Defence Spikers and VIP Spikers produced emphatic performances to secure decisive wins on Day Five of the ongoing 2026 volleyball competition.
In the women’s division, Nigeria Customs Service demonstrated absolute authority on the court, dismantling CNS Spikers in a straight-sets victory. Customs asserted control from the opening serve to comfortably claim all three sets and wrap up a dominant 3–0 win.
VIP Spikers also maintained their impressive form in the women’s category, cruising to a comprehensive 3–0 victory over Benue Queens. VIP Spikers outclassed their opponents in every department, giving Benue Queens no room to stage a comeback as they swept through the fixture with ease.
In the men’s division, Defence Spikers earned a hard-fought victory over NSCDC in a thrilling four-set battle. Defence Spikers took the opening set before NSCDC fought back to level the match by taking the second set.
However, Defence Spikers reclaimed the advantage in the third set and held their nerve through a fiercely contested fourth set to seal a 3–1 win.
The latest results further intensify the battle for dominance as teams in both categories push to build momentum ahead of their upcoming tournament fixtures.
